fact: Ministerial Decree 816 of 2025 issuing the executive regulations of the Personal Data Protection Law, published in the Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i al-Misriyya) issue 244 supplement (A) on 1 November 2025, gives the Personal Data Protection Center its operating rules.
title: قرار رقم 816 لسنة 2025 بإصدار اللائحة التنفيذية لقانون حماية البيانات الشخصية
